statement: A running model, not a calibrated one, and thinner than the wisteria model it is derived from: there was no prototype of this plant to carry numbers over from, so most are copied from wisteria or are placeholders. None has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.leafFlushDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.autumnColourDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: RHS: climbing hydrangeas flower on shoots made the previous year. Bud formation is taken as August; the dates are not from the source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Placed inside the RHS flowering envelope of early summer (9 to 29 June), on shoots made the summer before.

phenology.flowerLastsDays.basis: Not used: the flowerheads are taken to go over together.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: RHS: over 12 m in 10 to 20 years, and slow to start. A size band is not a growth rate; a placeholder.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader rate. Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. Rate is a placeholder.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: RHS: slow to establish. The factors are placeholders.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: Three stems from the base in the first season. A placeholder.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: RHS: over 12 m. Used as a cap on stem length; a height is not a route length, so this is a placeholder.
